tariq.s: PartnerEdge pinged us — they need a tiny marketplace sample repo for SI onboarding: one terraform module, one example per cloud, a marketplace manifest.yml, and a CI smoke job. target: 3 working days from our side.
emma.dev: ok, keep it minimal. structure idea: modules/partneredge-module/, examples/aws-min/, examples/azure-min/, examples/gcp-min/, ci/smoke.yml, marketplace/manifest.yml, docs/ONBOARDING.md
luis-partner: Please include brief cloud templates for Azure (ARM) and GCP (deployment) so their SI sees both patterns. They want copy/paste-ready snippets.
anna-market: Manifest must include product_id, vendor_contact, support_contact, sla_tier, regions, hardware_profiles, cert_level, packaging_format, compatibility (CUDA/driver), and size_estimates. Also add a 2-line marketing blurb and a quantization_recommendation field.
emma.dev: good call. For hardware_profiles we'll recommend t4, g4dn, and a100 as examples and add suggested quantization: fp16 for latency-sensitive, int8 for cost-savvy.
tariq.s: CI must be lightweight — no real GPU. Use a tiny container stub or local emulator. Workflow should do terraform init/apply (small infra), run a healthcheck, then destroy. Keep 10m timeout.
emma.dev: sample variables snippet for README to paste: ```hcl
variable "instance_type" {
  type    = string
  default = "t4.large"
}
variable "replicas" {
  type    = number
  default = 1
}
```
anna-market: also include onboarding checklist in docs: register product_id, request certs, add support_contact, KMS integration notes for Private deployments, and packaging instructions for air-gapped customers.
onboarding-bot: Manifest linter: missing fields detected: support_contact, sla_tier. See https://partners.redwood.ai/marketplace-specs for required keys.
luis-partner: i'll provide example deploy.tfvars for each cloud and a tiny echo-server startup script for templates.
tariq.s: owner? Emma take module + CI, Anna handle manifest fields + linter, Luis supply cloud snippets. Deadline: PR by next Wed, review by Fri.
emma.dev: i'll open the PR with scaffold and CI smoke. tagging @anna-market for manifest review when ready. :rocket:
